_comment: CI regression gate for the OFFLINE smoke eval (synthetic mini corpus, hashing embedder, lexical reranker, fake LLM). Baselined from a measured run with `python -m filingqa.eval.gate results/offline/smoke_latest.json eval/thresholds.offline.json --write --abs-margin 0.05 --metrics recall@5,recall@10,mrr,faithfulness,refusal_accuracy,false_refusal_rate`. These numbers only guard the plumbing against regressions; they say nothing about real model quality.
